title: cogitator.yml
description: The cogitator dbt language server's per-project configuration file. Every section except 'startup:' hot-reloads; 'startup:' keys apply only via --config at launch.

inlay.description: Which inlay hints the server sends.

env_vars.description: Show the value each env_var() reads, secret-looking names masked (default true). (bool)

jinja.description: Show what short single-line {{ … }} expressions render to (default false). (bool)

types.description: Show each output column's inferred type after its select item (default false). (bool)

vars.description: Show the value each var() resolves to (default true). (bool)

artifact_mib.description: target/ artifact files past this size are skipped. (MiB)

compiled_sql_mib.description: dbt.compiledSql wire cap; bigger files answer uri-only. (MiB)

lint.description: Style diagnostics default to off; the macro call, dispatch and syntax checks default to on.

dead_models.description: Hint on models nothing downstream uses. (bool)

dispatch.description: Warn on adapter.dispatch calls with no default__ nor active-adapter implementation (default on). (bool)

macro_calls.description: Warn on macro calls whose arguments the macro does not take (default on). (bool)

select_star.description: Warn on SELECT * outside staging models. (bool)

syntax.description: Report Jinja and SQL syntax errors as you type, without dbt compile (default on). (bool)

trailing_comma.description: Warn on trailing commas the dialect rejects. (bool)

unaliased_columns.description: Warn on bare columns in multi-relation FROM/JOINs. (bool)

undocumented_columns.description: Hint on produced columns missing from the schema YAML. (bool)

log.description: What reaches the editor's log view (window/logMessage).

client_level.description: Verbosity of the editor-visible log stream; $/setTrace adjusts it too (last writer wins). (off|error|warn|info|debug)

perf.description: Query-plan performance diagnostics; dbt.queryPlan always works, whatever is set here.

catalog_stats.description: Use catalog statistics when ordering findings; statistics never raise a severity. (bool)

inline_findings.description: Also show the reported findings as inlay hints, with the whole finding as the tooltip (default false). (bool)

profile.description: Which rules report as diagnostics: off (default), recommended or strict. (off|recommended|strict)

row_hints.description: Show the row counts catalog statistics prove for each CTE as inlay hints (default true). (bool)

perf_rules.description: Per-rule severity, by rule id; wins over the profile. A rule named here reports even under profile off.

cross.ephemeral_repeat.description: Ephemeral model recomputed in each consumer. (off|hint|info|warning)

cross.filter_late.description: Every consumer repeats the same filter. (off|hint|info|warning)

cross.select_star_chain.description: SELECT * reading columns nothing downstream uses (also lint.select_star). (off|hint|info|warning)

cross.unused_column.description: No downstream use in this project. (off|hint|info|warning)

filter.cluster_order.description: Filter skips the leading cluster column. (off|hint|info|warning)

incr.could_be_incremental.description: A table that could be built incrementally. (off|hint|info|warning)

incr.missing_guard.description: Incremental model reprocesses all input each run. (off|hint|info|warning)

join.fanout.description: This join may duplicate rows: the key is not known to be unique (on by default). (off|hint|info|warning)

join.left_nullified.description: WHERE makes this LEFT JOIN inner. (off|hint|info|warning)

limit.no_scan_reduction.description: LIMIT does not reduce bytes read. (off|hint|info|warning)

order.in_cte.description: ORDER BY has no effect here. (off|hint|info|warning)

subq.not_in_nullable.description: NOT IN over a nullable column can return nothing. (off|hint|info|warning)

type.text_temporal_compare.description: Text compared with a date or time (types.checks). (off|hint|info|warning)

preview.description: dbt.previewCte (the "Preview rows" lenses): how many rows a preview shows.

max_rows.description: The most rows a preview may ask for; larger limits are capped (default 1000). (rows)

rows.description: Rows a preview shows when the call names no limit (default 20). (rows)

profiles.description: dbt profiles overrides — hot: editing these re-resolves the active profile/target.

allow.description: Profiles readable besides the project's own (like --profiles-allow). ([names])

profile.description: Active profile override; empty means the project's own. (name)

startup.description: Launch-only keys (install-once subsystems); honored via --config, a restart applies changes.

debug.description: Plain-text logging to log.txt beside the executable. (bool)

fusion.description: dbt Fusion binary path enabling compile diagnostics. (path)

otlp.description: OTLP trace/metric export endpoint; empty uses the SDK default. (url)

types.description: Type checks: text compared with dates, sums over text, mismatched join keys (type-* diagnostics).

checks.description: Report the type.* checks and join.key_type_mismatch under every perf profile (default true); a Warning only when both types are proven. (bool)

vars.description: Var overrides, like dbt's --vars: name → value. They win over dbt_project.yml and are passed to the dbt commands the server runs.

columns.description: Complete source columns from the warehouse when the YAML has none. (bool)
